final: WITH j AS (SELECT o.timespan AS ts, COUNT(*) AS c FROM riskandmargin r JOIN orders o ON r.ordervault = o.recordvault GROUP BY o.timespan), s AS (SELECT ts, c, c*1.0/(SELECT SUM(c) FROM j) AS sh FROM j), a AS (SELECT AVG(sh) AS av FROM s) SELECT SUM(c) AS total_count, AVG(sh) AS avg_share, AVG(sh - (SELECT av FROM a)) AS avg_excess FROM s WHERE sh > (SELECT av FROM a)
